# e2357b58 = #1057 (on an older main, hence another tree); 25b565cc = pinned stage; 47ef1241 = fused glue (message
# reworded from c8dc633c, the same tree); all four #1057 copies in the builds share one tree and #1057's patch-id.

## Script
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# prints patch-ids and trees for the given commits, each with its parent as the diff base
for c in "$@"; do
    printf '%s  parent %s  tree %s  patch-id %s\n' "$(git rev-parse --short=12 "$c")" "$(git rev-parse --short=12 "$c^")" \
        "$(git rev-parse --short=12 "$c^{tree}")" "$(git diff "$c^" "$c" | git patch-id --stable | cut -c1-40)"
done
